blueprint.objective: Compare three fictional payroll software vendors (Acme Payroll, BrightPay Cloud, Cobalt HR) for a 200-employee company and produce a side-by-side comparison with a single recommendation justified by the buyer's stated priorities.

tasks.responsibility: Profile Acme Payroll's capabilities, pricing model, and fit for the buyer described in company_profile. Cover the same dimensions as the other two vendor profiles so the comparison is apples-to-apples.

Profile BrightPay Cloud's capabilities, pricing model, and fit for the buyer described in company_profile. Cover the same dimensions as the other two vendor profiles so the comparison is apples-to-apples.
Profile Cobalt HR's capabilities, pricing model, and fit for the buyer described in company_profile. Cover the same dimensions as the other two vendor profiles so the comparison is apples-to-apples.

Synthesise the three vendor profiles into a side-by-side comparison table covering identical dimensions, then select one vendor as the recommendation and justify it with a rationale that traces back to the buyer's stated priorities in company_profile. All vendor details are fictional and illustrative.

tasks.role: Reviewer for Write Comparison Report and Recommendation
tasks.responsibility: Review the output of 'Write Comparison Report and Recommendation' against the rubric.

output_schema.name: approved
output_schema.description: True only if every criterion is met

output_schema.name: feedback
output_schema.description: Concrete revision instructions for the maker

patterns.rationale: 3 tasks have no dependency on each other; fan out and join at comparison_report
these tasks consume predecessor outputs; run in dependency order

rubric: Every vendor is assessed on the same set of dimensions in the comparison table; no vendor has a dimension the others lack.
The recommendation is one of the three named vendors and is explicitly justified by at least two of the buyer's stated priorities from company_profile.
The rationale entries reference specific strengths or weaknesses from the three research outputs rather than introducing new, unsupported claims.
No factual or numerical claim is presented as real-world data; all content is clearly framed as illustrative.
